ios.desc:
Know the weather where the action is. imWeather helps you find a sports venue, save it, and check outdoor conditions before you leave, during the event, and on the way home.

PLAN AROUND THE VENUE
• Browse 348 venue shortcuts across football, basketball, tennis, cricket, baseball, racing, rugby, American football, hockey, and golf
• Search by venue, city, country, or sport
• Save venues alongside your everyday locations

PREPARE FOR GAME DAY
• Check temperature, feels-like conditions, wind, pressure, UV, visibility, and air quality
• Use the 36-hour forecast to plan arrival, event time, and the trip home
• Look a week ahead when choosing a day or deciding what to bring
• See sunrise, sunset, moonrise, and moon phase details

STAY READY
• Create alert areas for rain, wind, temperature, and official weather alerts where available
• Set daily briefings and quiet hours
• Add Home Screen widgets and choose your units, tint, and app icon

imWeather Pro unlocks advanced alerts for more locations, helping you stay informed without repeatedly checking the forecast.

Forecasts describe outdoor weather at the venue location. imWeather does not provide scores, schedules, ticketing, or indoor conditions.
